test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: GIEK is related to OQMS in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, KMIO is related to SUQW. To which of the following is EGCI related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'GIEK is related to OQMS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ea62d824295e3c1996a6cb7cf96f4eedbef62ead22afb07cb8bec28ebac299.png] 

For, 'KMIO is related to SUQW'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5f0204a1bd67c45f01f927dee460369835fb39b1723368b0ed4d60261edba0c.png] 

Similarly, for '**EGCI**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501eefd9e00f87de88d15c9f4d80199e5a668fb218cff31023c4b32e3c31ef08.png] 

So, 'EGCI' will be related to '**MOKQ**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
